svg.title: Protocol and transport architecture
svg.desc: Application - routes and handlers; Protocol - parsing, semantics, serialization; Shared contract - messages, byte sources, channel intent; Windows transport - IOCP; Linux transport - epoll. Bidirectional connections: Application to Protocol, Protocol to Shared contract, Shared contract to Windows transport, and Shared contract to Linux transport.
